title: Caixa Vida e Previdência breach: scope and ANPD wording
what_changed: Summary said all listed data types were copied for 7.6 million clients and that ANPD is reviewing the response. Folha PE (Estadão Conteúdo) says names and CPFs for all records, other data for part, the base covers 7.6 million active clients plus ex-clients, and the company notified ANPD on 11 November; no ANPD review is stated.
